prompt.text:
Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Return Solution.java defining public final class Solution.
Required API: public static String parseNetstring(String text), returning null on failure
Behavior: Parse exactly one ASCII netstring length:payload,. The length is decimal bytes with no sign and no leading zero except the single digit 0; payload must be printable ASCII, its byte length must match, and no trailing data is allowed.
Visible example: "5:hello," produces "hello", while "05:hello," fails.

Buggy source to repair:

public final class Solution { public static String parseNetstring(String s){int c=s.indexOf(':');if(c<0)return null;int n=Integer.parseInt(s.substring(0,c));String p=s.substring(c+1).replace(",","");return p.length()>=n?p.substring(0,n):null;} }

reference.code: public final class Solution { public static String parseNetstring(String s){int i=0;while(i<s.length()&&s.charAt(i)>='0'&&s.charAt(i)<='9')i++;if(i==0||i>=s.length()||s.charAt(i)!=':'||(i>1&&s.charAt(0)=='0'))return null;int n;try{n=Integer.parseInt(s.substring(0,i));}catch(Exception e){return null;}int end=i+1+n;if(end+1!=s.length()||end<0||s.charAt(end)!=',')return null;String p=s.substring(i+1,end);for(int j=0;j<p.length();j++)if(p.charAt(j)<32||p.charAt(j)>126)return null;return p;} }
